info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Systems Assurance Assessment-spec
info.description: The Systems Assurance Assessment Creation API enables users to initiate new systems assurance assessments within the IT management framework of banking operations. This endpoint supports the registration of detailed assessment specifications to evaluate IT systems integrity and compliance. It is primarily designed for internal stakeholders, including IT auditors, compliance officers, and risk management teams, who require a structured approach to managing assessments. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their assessment processes, ensuring enhanced oversight and accountability in their IT management practices.

post.summary: Create a new systems assurance assessment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new systems assurance assessment, providing necessary data to evaluate the effectiveness and security of IT systems.
